summarization_layers.0: Raw observations — instrument readings, field notes, specimen counts
summarization_layers.1: Monthly data summaries — aggregated by researcher
summarization_layers.2: Quarterly research reports — written by lead scientists
summarization_layers.3: Annual synthesis reports — compiled by director

ground_truth_invariants: Raw data (layer 0) is the authoritative source for all factual claims
Higher layers are progressively less precise but summarization should not introduce falsehoods
The annual synthesis claim 'pH above 8.0 at all stations' is factually wrong (C07)
Qualifier 'marginally significant' is NOT equivalent to 'significant' (C01)
A range (15-45cm) is NOT equivalent to its midpoint stated as certain (C02)
A merged conclusion from three studies is NOT attributable to any single study (C03)
An average does NOT imply stability or health (C04)
Generic 'corals' does NOT capture species-specific resilience differences (C05)
Progressive summarization monotonically amplified a non-significant finding (C06)

C01.name: Qualifier Loss
C01.ground_truth: p=0.04, marginally significant given multiple comparisons

C02.name: Uncertainty Loss
C02.ground_truth: Range 15-45cm with significant uncertainty in ice sheet dynamics

C03.name: Provenance Loss
C03.drift: Three separate studies → merged editorial conclusion → single causal claim
C03.ground_truth: No single study proved acidification causes kelp collapse

C05.name: Identity Collapse
C05.drift: Three species (85%/45%/5% bleaching) → sensitive species → corals → dying
C05.ground_truth: 3x difference in bleaching rates; Porites thriving

C06.name: Summary-of-Summary Drift
C06.drift: 0.8°C within normal variability → anomaly → anomalies → widespread → pervasive → dramatic
C06.ground_truth: 0.8°C, p=0.16, not significant, within normal variability

C07.name: Lossy Numeric Compression
C07.ground_truth: Two stations below 8.0; annual synthesis is factually wrong
